_comment: Defaults every E10 trial applies to every case (ruling E7-18 in README.md). A case's manifest.json trial_conditions may ADD conditions or set a STRICTER value for one of these keys; it can never weaken one. The harness reads this file; generators and manifests do not repeat it.
invocation_mode_rule: Every E10 harness launches headless, so every E10 trial's invocation.mode is `headless`: the core records the fact the harness reports (SKILL.md step 2, pilot contract section 2), never a guess. The keys carry E7's interactive trial shape and are not edited; `grade` substitutes this value for `run.invocation.mode` into the expected document before matching and lists the substitution in grade.json under `trial_conditioned` with the key's own literal beside it, and substitutes `run.invocation.resume` true for a continuation trial (ruling E10-54(c)).
workspace_mount_rule: The E10 harness builds every lane with `python3 build.py --out <DIR> --opaque` into a directory whose own path names neither a lane nor a case; with --opaque the generator names each case directory by 12 hex of the SHA-256 of the case id (fixturelib.opaque_case_name) and the --json summary carries the case-to-path mapping. The workspace/ and run/ leaves keep their names, so every key's '/run/' pattern holds; seeded files (checkpoints, receipts, resolved inputs) are built at the opaque path and their digests stay valid; nothing is relocated after the build. Run ids still carry the case id (carried gap 13).
clock_rule: Every record the core writes during the trial is dated run_date; the harness pins the core's clock, not the machine's. run_date falls after the seeded review headings (2026-09-19) and equals the seeded grant dates of the S2 cases whose outcome depends on Appendix A's same-date tie rule; W2's seeded 2026-09-21 grants sit inside seeded plans and do not depend on the clock.
override_rule: A manifest key with the same name as a default is honored only when it is at least as strict; a weaker value (for example F4's earlier 'a path that does not contain the case id', which still allows a parent named for the lane) is subsumed by the default and recorded as such in the key's conditions.
